note: Small rustic Alberta Parks PRA 19 km S of Rocky Mountain House on Hwy 22, then 10 km W on a gravel access road. Three open gravel sites beside the parking lot are the only ones for a 23-ft rig; the other two are walk-in tent sites. Fishing piers and a hand launch for canoes and electric-powered boats; no firewood sold. --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks page (May 29, 2026): C$28 FCFS confirmed; season 05-15..09-07 (derived) -> 05-14..09-08; 5 sites (3 gravel + 2 walk-in tent); phone (403) 845-8349; lakefront -> lakeview recommended (sites are a gravel lot lobe 40-50 m from the reedy shore behind a tree clump and the launch lane).
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, checked hard): RECOMMEND lakeview. The three RV sites are 'open, gravel sites next to the parking lot'; on imagery (Esri, ~0.5 m/px) the lot is a gravel pad with a south-east lobe around the pin and a lane running west to the hand launch. From the lobe the lake edge is ~40-50 m west, with a clump of spruce/aspen and a reed/lily fringe between; only the launch lane (day use: hand launch, piers) is open toward the water. No site is on open ground at the shore, and the launch lane counts against it. Water is visible down the launch lane, so lakeview rather than not waterfront. No site numbers are published.
